concerns.location: plan.md:Section 'Complexity Tracking & Resolved Concerns' – line stating “Added explicit power note (≥ 100 stories gives > 80 % power for medium effect).”
concerns.text: The power justification is vague; no effect‑size estimate, simulation, or reference is provided. For a permutation‑test RSA comparison across three ROIs, a formal power analysis (e.g., via Monte‑Carlo simulation) should be documented to ensure ≥ 80 % power for the expected effect size.

concerns.location: plan.md:Task T042 description – “Compute RSA matrices (Pearson correlation) between each model’s hidden states and each ROI’s neural RDM”
concerns.text: The plan does not specify how inter‑subject variability will be handled. RSA should be computed per subject and then aggregated (e.g., mixed‑effects model) or a subject‑level permutation should be included to avoid confounding subject differences with model effects.
